title: Code and data for: Network topology of marine seismic hazard chains and contrasts with inland earthquake chains
description: Reproducibility deposit for the manuscript by Shi, Hu and Zhang (prepared for Natural Hazards). A single R Markdown document (marine_hazard_chains_reproduction.Rmd) regenerates every table and figure of the paper from the raw documented cascade tables: the marine seismic hazard-chain network (39 nodes / 152 directed edges from 366 documented chains under 58 tsunami source events), the comparison with an inland earthquake network (84 events, 500 chains) at a unified 15-class resolution, the robustness checks (event-level cluster bootstrap, edge-frequency thresholds, five-fold out-of-sample edge coverage), the independent-event test against three further tsunamis with chance baselines, the node-removal analysis, and the data of the interactive network viewer.
